message: Hi, my little one Rex is 5 and wants to try martial arts. Do you have classes for that age?

Hi! Yes, we do have kids programs. We offer Youth MMA and Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu depending on which location you're interested in.
Is Rex looking to try a specific style, or are you open to seeing what's the best fit for him?
We're open to seeing what's the best fit for him! What class times do you have available?

Great! For a 5-year-old, Youth MMA would be perfect. It's offered Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 4:30 PM to 5:15 PM.
The best way to start is with a free trial class so Rex can try it out and see if he loves it. Would one of those days work for you?
Monday at 4:30 PM works for us! How do we sign up for the free trial class?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial class details to?
You can send the details to tester.indigo@gmail.com.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! Now I just need Rex's full name and date of birth to complete the booking.
Rex's full name is Rex Indigo, and he was born on September 2, 2020.

Perfect! I have a few options for Rex's free trial class. The next Monday available would be July 14th at 4:30 PM, or I can get you in sooner on Wednesday July 8th or Friday July 10th at 4:30 PM. Which works best?
Let's go with Wednesday, July 8th at 4:30 PM!

Awesome! Rex is all set for his free trial class on Wednesday, July 8th at 4:30 PM. We'll send a confirmation to tester.indigo@gmail.com. Just bring Rex in comfortable clothes and we'll take care of the rest. See you both then!
